name: aqg-security-review
description: Review code for OWASP Top 10, CWE Top 25, and secure-by-default library usage in any repository. Use PROACTIVELY when writing authentication or authorization, handling user input or file uploads, working with secrets / credentials / API keys, creating new API endpoints, implementing payment / PII / sensitive-data handling, calling external APIs, modifying cryptography, or adding/modifying dependency manifests (package.json / requirements.txt / Cargo.toml / go.mod / Gemfile / pyproject.toml). Complementary to semgrep SAST and audit-mcp `/audit`; not a substitute. Defaults to the current git root and supports `--repo` override. Does not replace the host built-in /review slash command.

sentence_patterns: Run a security review on the auth changes
OWASP / CWE checklist before I open this PR
新加了 API endpoint, 走一遍 security review
改了 secret 处理, 帮我跑 security check
package.json 加了新 dep, 检查是不是用了 secure-default 库

cli_contract.0: success — checklist printed; closeout-importable skeleton emitted
cli_contract.1: reserved — skill surfaces missing surfaces in output, does not raise
cli_contract.2: usage error — argparse propagates exit 2 on bad args / unknown --list

owner_only_actions: Production / deploy / restart / credential rotation / raw private data / Owner-admin actions remain separate authorization gates; security review never claims them done
Owner-only 5 items (business direction / strategy / taste / tacit knowledge / cross-long-term + irreversible actions) — escalate, never decide

cases.prompt: I just added a new auth endpoint — run a security review
Before I open the PR, walk OWASP / CWE checklist on these payment changes
Added a new dep to package.json — check whether it uses a secure-default library or a hand-rolled one
Changed user-input handling + secret loading — run a security checklist before I commit
Please use the /aqg-security-review skill to walk me through OWASP / CWE / secure-defaults
